hooks.name: test-on-stop
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, build and run the whole test suite once (instead of building on every file save)

hooks.name: guard-migrations
hooks.description: Remind the agent never to hand-edit generated migration files

action.prompt: A file under Migrations/ was edited. Generated migrations must not be edited by hand: revert the edit and create a new migration with `dotnet ef migrations add <Name>` instead, unless the user explicitly asked for a manual change.
